source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Points are named with capital letters, lines with small letters or by two of their points; a line is endless both ways.
stages.headlineEnglish: Points are named with capital letters, lines with small letters or by two of their points; a line is endless both ways.

stages.headline: Through two points passes exactly one line; two lines have either one common point or none.
stages.headlineEnglish: Through two points passes exactly one line; two lines have either one common point or none.

stages.headline: A segment is the part of a line made of two points and all points between them; A and B are its endpoints.
stages.headlineEnglish: A segment is the part of a line made of two points and all points between them; A and B are its endpoints.

stages.headline: How many lines can be drawn through two given points?

stages.headline: At most how many intersection points can three lines have?
